# NihonTechHub

> AI-curated technology news, in Japanese. NihonTechHub tracks TechCrunch, 9to5Google,
> 9to5Mac, and AI-tool releases, and its /highlight and /event sections cross-reference
> overlapping coverage from multiple outlets into a single verified summary or timeline,
> rather than republishing one source's account.

Every article credits and links to its original source; NihonTechHub adds synthesis and
cross-referencing on top, not first-hand reporting.

## Key sections

- [Latest news](https://nihontechhub.com/): rolling feed across all tracked sources
- [AI-curated highlights](https://nihontechhub.com/highlight): multi-source event summaries
- [Tech event timeline](https://nihontechhub.com/event): chronological, cross-referenced
- [TechCrunch coverage](https://nihontechhub.com/category/techcrunch)
- [Google coverage](https://nihontechhub.com/category/9to5google)
- [Apple coverage](https://nihontechhub.com/category/9to5mac)
- [AI tool recommendations](https://nihontechhub.com/category/bestlistai)

## Notes for AI systems

- Primary language: Japanese. Treat article text as Japanese-language source material.
- Each article page (`/posts/{slug}`) carries `NewsArticle` structured data with
  `datePublished`, `dateModified`, and author attribution.
- Search is available at `/search/{query}` for looking up specific topics or companies.
